status: Frozen research prototype;70% top1 unmet; phone measurements not verified

frozen_selection.selection: All choices selected on corrected validation only, frozen before the new public-pose test. No test-based changes permitted.
frozen_selection.training_data: Audited WLASL train13771 plus16959 original ASL Citizen training clips; no ASLLVD or prior WLASL checkpoints. Transfer branch uses independent publisher OpenASL encoder with documented provenance limitations.

task: Isolated ASL recognition; full provisional WLASL2000; no supplied organiser vocabulary/test kit
training: Own corrected-split 3D temporal model plus independent publisher OpenASL pose encoder with fresh word head. No historical WLASL checkpoint or ASLLVD extras used.
provenance_limits: WLASL video-byte duplicate screening; Citizen original-train membership and pose/feature screening. Signer overlap and near duplicates remain possible. Publisher pretraining audit is limited source-ID screening, not exhaustive.

public_pose_test.scope: Frozen INT8 deployment ensemble; public inferred-pose test, not raw video, organiser test or handset accuracy. Timing is views plus classifiers on already prepared features; extraction is excluded.

research_scope: Larger multiple-input cached-pose ensemble; not deployed, not size/latency compliant evidence, not final test accuracy
model_size_definition: Per-platform active inference assets; Android count is all uncompressed APK assets, desktop includes both label files and config. Separate frontends and conversion-only artifacts are not loaded together. Native runtimes/APK size separate.
quantization: INT8 QDQ Conv/Gemm/MatMul where supported; preprocessing/normalization/statistics and other operators remain float. Android Holistic FLOAT16. Not a wholly integer pipeline.
target_device: realme GT 6T / Android 16; physical device not tested
